page.title: Quest Creator OS
page.subtitle: Automate the machine loop. Spend the seat on design, spacing, and play feel.

machines.label: OMEN
machines.detail: Dual Intel Arc B70s and two displays make this the place for Valheim feel, Studio authorship, spatial judgment, and visual review. It is not the fleet's manual KVM.

machines.label: AM4
machines.detail: Online after the motherboard swap and available to the wider lab. Quest still integrates with platform services only through published packages and verified release files.

machines.label: i5
machines.detail: Offline nearby. Leave it off for creator-content and spatial work; start it only when the multiplayer event adapter itself changes.

environment.label: Repository baseline
environment.detail: Creator OS implementation is recorded in 7860288 while the pre-existing Quest Lab Gallery work remains preserved in the same committed change.

environment.label: Creator Session
environment.detail: Prepare, Status, Arm, Lab identity, Disarm, and Close completed in the corrected live OMEN session with matching install, machine, world, session, and request identities. Exact backup/restore and rejection branches remain executable-fixture covered.

environment.label: Runtime creator surface
environment.detail: The corrected live control plane passed Arm, armed/watching Status, Lab identity, Disarm, and clean log inspection. Passive window capture found the compact y=48 bar behind the host HUD ending at y=84; the clamped y=92 geometry is build- and executable-test proven and awaits the next normal launch.

environment.label: Godbuild round trip
environment.detail: Capture import, normalized authority, typed plan, deterministic SVG, drift check, check-before-build, and MATCH-only replay are executable-test covered.

recovery.title: Creator OS operating lane
recovery.summary: One leased session owns deployment, identity, requests, capture transport, proof, and rollback. Derek enters the loop only where human spatial judgment or play feel is the product.

cold_load.title: Prepare one pinned Creator Session
cold_load.instruction: With Valheim closed, run Prepare once. Use its returned session id for every later operation; do not hand-copy files, relay console commands, or change worlds mid-session.
cold_load.verdict: Did this lane complete without turning Derek into the fleet's manual KVM?

creator_flow.title: Run the machine-owned creator session
creator_flow.summary: The six steps below are rendered from the checked-in Creator Session choreography, whose preconditions are ordered from Prepare through MATCH and Close.
creator_flow.heading: Creator session loop

revision_flow.title: Move one authored idea through the whole product
revision_flow.summary: Studio keeps the creator in one telling; Godbuild turns human spacing into reviewable, replayable source instead of a manual reconstruction job.
revision_flow.source_sequence: Author -> Rehearse -> Play -> Observe -> Capture Godbuild -> Replay elsewhere
revision_flow.source_contains: Author -> Rehearse -> Play -> Observe -> Capture Godbuild -> Replay elsewhere
revision_flow.edit_source_contains: The first real Godbuild target is intentionally small
revision_flow.suggested_edit: Build one small room or lane with human spacing, capture it once, review the generated source, then replay it elsewhere and require MATCH.

phase3_lap.title: Parked Phase 3 exit lap
phase3_lap.summary: This remains a valid, source-derived five-step lap with exactly three human verdicts. Batch it into a later creative sitting; do not interrupt Creator OS construction for it.

queue.title: Passively verify the safe-top bar
queue.detail: On the next normal Valheim launch, automation owns deployment, direct window-buffer capture, host-band clearance, and clean Close. Do not schedule a dedicated seat lap or ask Derek to press F9, relay a screenshot, or inspect logs.

queue.title: Capture the first human-spaced Godbuild
queue.detail: Use one small room or lane to prove capture, preview, typed plan, check, replay, and MATCH before scaling the content.
queue.source_contains: The first real Godbuild target is intentionally small

queue.title: Batch the Phase 3 feel verdicts
queue.detail: Take the desperate-defense judgments together during a later creative sitting; the machine checks stay with the harness.
queue.source_contains: Phase 3's remaining combat-feel verdicts are parked

queue.title: Scale into community artifacts
queue.detail: After one live MATCH loop, use the capture and blueprint as replay authority while pack v3 and provenance work advance.

decisions.title: Seat capacity
decisions.question: What work is allowed to consume Derek's time at the keyboard?
decisions.recommendation: Only authored choices, spatial judgment, visual review, and play feel. Deployment, relays, capture transport, and proof belong to the machine loop.
decisions.source_contains: The seat is for spatial judgment

decisions.title: Runtime surface
decisions.question: Does the overhead bar replace the old F9 drawer?
decisions.recommendation: Yes. F9 expands or minimizes one always-present overhead bar; a single clamped alert anchor carries deadline or actionable warning state.

decisions.title: Fleet roles
decisions.question: When should the nearby i5 peer be powered on?
decisions.recommendation: Only when the multiplayer adapter changes. Content-only and spatial work stay on the Creator Session lane without a human relay between machines.
decisions.source_contains: i5 stays off for content-only and spatial work

commands.label: Prepare Creator Session
commands.detail: With Valheim closed: lease, build, backup, deploy, hash-pin, and open the private-world safety window.

commands.label: Verify session pins
commands.detail: Read-only validation of the lease, machine, world, session, and installed payload hashes.

commands.label: Capture a Godbuild
commands.detail: Capture and inspect once, then automatically import and drift-check the review bundle.

commands.label: Re-run standalone import
commands.detail: Optional standalone entrypoint for an external Lab capture; Creator Session Capture already runs it.

commands.label: Replay after review
commands.detail: Run check, build, and translation-independent diff; fail unless the result is MATCH.

commands.label: Start Quest Studio
commands.detail: Open the four-stage Author, Rehearse, Play, Observe cockpit on the second display.

cautions: The Creator Session lease owns the shared Valheim installation. Do not run another deployment or Lab mutation beside it.
Rehearsal declares its own proof level, disclaimer, and limitations; it does not prove Unity, BepInEx, Harmony, or live mutation.
A screenshot or checkbox is orientation, not machine proof. Preserve request receipts, identity pins, capture hashes, and MATCH.
The live control plane is proven. The y=92 compact-bar geometry remains build-proven until automation passively captures it on the next normal Valheim launch.
